description: This file defines a Java interface for data access operations related to the 'Contract' entity, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide CRUD functionalities and custom finder methods.

classes.name: ContractRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Contract entity, providing methods to retrieve contracts based on client or user who accepted them.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contracts associated with the specified client.

methods.name: findByAcceptedBy
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contracts that were accepted by the specified user.
